evidence.quote: 1800 QSTUDY (1800 778 839) is Queensland's international student hotline, providing phone support and information related to studying in Queensland.
The hotline is available 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
It's free when you call from an Australian landline or mobile provider.
All international students can use the 1800 QSTUDY support service.
